Journalist Richa Parashar of Oneindia alleged that Rahul Gandhi grabbed her hand during the march on October 12, causing her to fall amid the commotion. She later spoke about the incident from a hospital.

recentItems.title: US Iran News Live: 'A Whole Civilization Will Die', Trump's 24-Hour Hormuz Ultimatum To Iran
recentItems.description:
Geopolitical tensions have reached a critical boiling point as United States President Donald Trump issued a stark 24-hour ultimatum to Iran, demanding unrestricted passage through the strategic Strait of Hormuz or face unprecedented military action. President Trump delivered a grave warning to Tehran, stating that failure to comply could result in the end of "a whole civilization," escalating the rhetoric in the volatile Persian Gulf region. The ultimatum follows heightened military posturing by both the U.S. and Iranian forces, raising global concerns over a potential full-scale conflict that could severely disrupt the world's oil supply and trigger a wider regional war.
